notes: Governing document: the HR Paid Parental Leave Benefit (2018_00_link), effective January 1, 2017, with its own Tenured/Tenure-Track Faculty section; Faculty Handbook 6.2.3.4 (revised 03/06/2017) defers to it ('as outlined in the Parental Leave Benefit information located on the Human Resources website'). The handbook's revision log quotes the removed 2012 maternity text (one semester at full pay, teaching relieved, other duties at 50% in research; 6 weeks if relieved of all duties); it is history, not coded.

The faculty birth-mother options (c1 semester, c2 part-time return, c3 6 weeks) are 'OR' alternatives, linked in_lieu_of pairwise (R15b). The non-birth options (c4 2 weeks, c5 40% semester) are linked in_lieu_of.

'Primary caregiver' is read as the adoptive path (Eligibility: 'Includes adoption (primary caregiver) ... Employee must certify that they are the primary caregiver'); whether a non-birth biological parent who is the primary caregiver may take the birth-mother options is not stated (flagged on c1-c3).
Staff (c12-c14) and non-tenure-track continuing/rolling-contract faculty (c15-c18) provisions are recorded with their group names and are not counted.

Chain, birth parent: either c1 (one semester full pay, teaching relieved, research continues; FMLA c6 concurrent from its start) or c3 (6 weeks paid leave, FMLA c6 concurrent, then own sick leave c7 or the unpaid FMLA remainder) or c2 (part-time return equal to 6 paid weeks); STD c8 (generic, terms not saved) unlinked.
Chain, non-birth parent: c4 (2 weeks paid leave, FMLA c6 concurrent, unpaid FMLA remainder) or c5 (one semester at 40% pay, no teaching or service; modified_duties at 40% pay).

Cited but not saved: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Policy (6.2.2 link); Short-Term Disability Policy (6.2.3.3); Eligible Benefits Chart (6.2.3.3); Tenure, Promotion, and Reappointment Procedures, Faculty Staffing Policy, Board of Trustees Policy 11.17, Bylaws and Policies 6.4, Senate Procedures 707.1.1 (2.2; none bears on leave). Handbook navigation also lists 6.2.1 General Conditions, 6.2.3.1 Approved Absences with Pay, 6.2.4.2 Informal Leave of Absence, 6.2.4.3 Leave for Military Service and 6.2.5 Return from a Leave, not saved.
